summary: Short, steep kerb at a corner with houses 19-29 m away on all sides.

best_section.where: West kerb of Eldon Street just past the corner, beside the corner house's garden

drivers.seclusion: Houses surround it: 19 m and 29 m on this side, a house 9 m beyond the far end, more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerbside lane on a quiet street; a couple of cars park nearby, but only about 9-17 m of kerb is clear of the junction.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a pedestrian crossing at the corner.
drivers.convention: Cars park on this street at the driveways, but no clear parking convention along this kerb.

flags: Steep: about 11% over the best section, 12.8% max
Close to the junction; short length for a van
Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Tree canopy to the south-east shades it in the morning; open to the afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Whether the kerb is far enough from the junction to park legally
